question: What did the supreme lord teach in the vira lineage?
premises: The supreme lord spoke to those in the vira lineage.
White and black, long and short, are paired.
Merit and demerit belong to day and night.
inference: The lord taught paired opposites of merit and demerit within day and night.
plain_english: Those were also spoken by the supreme lord in the vira lineage: white and black, long and short, merit and demerit, in day and night.
